steps.title: Prepare Column Wash Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the Column Wash Solution by adding ethanol and capping the container tightly.

steps.title: Prepare Lysate (Standard Protocol)
steps.instruction: Prepare the bacterial lysate using a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 600µl of bacterial culture to a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100µl of Cell Lysis Buffer (Blue) and mix by inverting the tube 6 times.
Add 350µl of cold (4–8°C) Neutralization Solution and mix thoroughly by inverting.
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column (Standard Protocol)
steps.instruction: Load the lysate onto the minicolumn and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (~900µl) to a PureYield™ Minicolumn without disturbing the cell debris pellet.
Place the minicolumn into a Collection Tube and centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 15 seconds.
Discard the flowthrough and place the minicolumn back into the same Collection Tube.

steps.title: Wash Column (Standard Protocol)
steps.instruction: Wash the minicolumn to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of Endotoxin Removal Wash (ERB) to the minicolumn and centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 seconds.
Add 400µl of Column Wash Solution (CWC) to the minicolumn and centrifuge at maximum speed for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA (Standard Protocol)
steps.instruction: Elute the purified plasmid DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the minicolumn to a clean 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 30µl of Elution Buffer or nuclease-free water directly to the minicolumn matrix.
Let stand for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds to elute the plasmid DNA.
Cap the tube and store eluted plasmid DNA at –20°C.

steps.title: Alternative Harvest for Higher Yields
steps.instruction: Harvest and process up to 3ml of bacterial culture to increase yield and purity.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 1.5ml of bacterial culture for 30 seconds at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge and discard the supernatant.
Add an additional 1.5ml of bacterial culture to the same tube and repeat the centrifugation/discard step.
Add 600µl of TE Buffer or water to the cell pellet and resuspend completely.
Proceed to the lysis steps of the standard protocol (adding Cell Lysis Buffer and Neutralization Solution).

steps.title: Prepare Lysate (Vacuum Protocol)
steps.instruction: Prepare the bacterial lysate for use with a vacuum manifold.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 1.5ml of culture to a 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 1 minute and discard the medium.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 600µl of TE buffer or water.
Add 100µl of Cell Lysis Buffer (Blue) and mix by inverting the tube 6 times.
Add 350µl of cold (4–8°C) Neutralization Solution and mix thoroughly by inverting.
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column (Vacuum Protocol)
steps.instruction: Use a vacuum manifold to pull the lysate through the column.

substeps.instruction: Place a PureYield™ minicolumn on a Luer-Lok® adapter of a VacMan® or VacMan® Jr Laboratory Vacuum manifold.
Transfer the supernatant (~900µl) into the PureYield™ Minicolumn.
Apply vacuum to pull the lysate through the column.

steps.title: Wash Column (Vacuum Protocol)
steps.instruction: Wash the minicolumn using vacuum suction.

substeps.instruction: Add 200µl of Endotoxin Removal Wash (ERB) to the minicolumn and allow the vacuum to pull the solution through.
Add 400µl of Column Wash Solution (CWC) to the minicolumn and allow the vacuum to pull the solution through.
Release the vacuum and remove the PureYield™ Minicolumn.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA (Vacuum Protocol)
steps.instruction: Dry the column and elute the purified plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: Place the column in a 2ml collection tube and centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge for 1 minute.
Transfer the minicolumn into a clean 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 30µl of Elution Buffer or nuclease-free water directly to the minicolumn matrix.
Let stand for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 15 seconds to elute the plasmid DNA.
Cap the tube and store eluted plasmid DNA at –20°C.

steps.title: Alternative Harvest for Vacuum Protocol
steps.instruction: Harvest up to 3ml of culture for the vacuum-based process.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge 1.5ml of bacterial culture for 30 seconds at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge.
Add an additional 1.5ml of bacterial culture to the same tube and repeat the centrifugation.
Add 600µl of TE buffer or water to the cell pellet and resuspend completely.
Proceed to the lysis steps of the vacuum protocol.
